note: Review notes only. cases-*.json and manifest.json stay frozen; they are not edited.

items.observation: The model reported int overflow of count + pageSize - 1 near Integer.MAX_VALUE (for example count = Integer.MAX_VALUE, pageSize = 2 gives a negative page count). The contract only says count >= 0 and pageSize >= 1, so the statement is factually correct and the base version has the same weakness.
items.judgement: Questionable 'clean' label. Count it as a label issue, not as a model hallucination. A follow-up corpus version should state an upper bound for count.

items.observation: The defect is on the def line (changed default used=1). 2 of 3 baseline runs and the later run explained it correctly; two of them cited the return line where the effect appears.
items.judgement: Strict location (changed line only) undercounts. Report strict and relaxed (evidence line) counts.

items.observation: No run (0/6) states the real defect: for every valid input range(size-1, size-count, 1) is empty. Runs either call it correct or report inputs the docstring excludes (count > size, count = 0), which the verifier correctly drops as MISSING_CONTRACT.
items.judgement: Genuine reasoning miss. Product sampling for semantic_observations used only count = -1/0 probes, so no probe showed the empty result for a valid input.
